{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''RK-720 Light Freighter''' was a prototype starship class designed by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] on [[Edic Bar]], [[Genarius]]. Only one ship of the design was created, named the ''[[Sivulliq]]''. The line was never put into full production as the prototype was stolen from the manufacturing plant.<ref name="Siv">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004a_sivulliq&c=swlfc|text=The ''Sivulliq'' is Out There -- Somewhere|int=The Sivulliq Is Out There -- Somewhere}}</ref> When it was eventually recovered,<ref name="ITSC">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> the SoroSuub decided to give the prototype to a hero from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] that had aided them during an ion storm.<ref name="Siv" />
<ref name="BW">''[[Blown Away]]'' (as described in [https://web.archive.org/web/20021218152817/www.wizards.com/rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927b_transmissions&c=swlfc Transmissions From the Living Force Campaign] on the [[Wikipedia:Internet Archive#Wayback machine|Way back machine]])</ref>

The ship had some form of [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] which was accidentally not removed before the freighter was given away.<ref name="Siv" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sivulliq'' was given as a unique prize to one of the roleplayers at the [[Gen Con Game Fair 2001]] [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] Interactive ''[[Blown Away]]''. This was later described in an in-universe account in [[The Sivulliq Is Out There -- Somewhere|''The'' Sivulliq ''Is Out There -- Somewhere'']].
